title: Mechanistic study on the photocatalytic degradation of rhodamine B via Mn–Schiff-base-modified Keggin-type polyoxometalate composite materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12364-12371
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08382B, Paper
Open Access

Chang Man, Chunpeng Xu, Jinfeng Wang, Xiangli Li, Tong Li, Yanhua Ma, Shalu Zhang, Yongfeng Qiao, Qiong Wu
This study synthesizes five hybrid complexes based on silicotungstic acid modified by diverse MnL [L = Salen(L1), 5-Br-Salen(L2), 5-Cl-Salen(L3), 3-Me-Salen(L4) and di-tBu-Salen(L5)] for the degradation of Rhodamine B under UV irradiation.
